cim: Sources: a faction of Nvidia board members is pushing for Jensen Huang's return despite Chair Harvey Jones stating the board has no plans to reinstate Huang (Semafor)
cim_eredeti: Sources: a faction of Nvidia board members is pushing for Jensen Huang's return despite Chair Harvey Jones stating the board has no plans to reinstate Huang (Semafor)
szoveg_eredeti:
Despite Nvidia’s proclamation Tuesday that it didn’t plan to bring ousted CEO Jensen Huang back to the chipmaker, a faction of board members is pushing for his return, according to people familiar with the matter.

Huang has met with a number of tech executives and spoken with at least one board member about the possibility of his return, the people said.

The conversation with the director took place before the company’s earnings report and before Huang issued a public statement Tuesday that he’d be willing to return to the company if the board decides it is in the “best interest of our shareholders, our employees, the company, and America.”

Hours later, Nvidia chairman Harvey Jones said on the company’s earnings call that the chipmaker wasn’t considering bringing Huang back and that the board had voted unanimously to accept his resignation.

Spokespeople for Huang and Nvidia declined to comment.

Despite the pushback from three directors, other board members are starting to narrow the search for Huang’s replacement, some of the people familiar with the deliberations said.

ARM CEO Rene Haas and Marvell CEO Matt Murphy have both been considered, the people said. Haas has spoken to at least some Nvidia directors about taking the job, one of the people said, but he’s said he’s concerned about the optics of taking it over calls to bring Huang back to the helm.

Spokespeople for ARM and Marvell didn’t immediately respond to requests for comment. It’s also unclear whether Marvell’s Murphy would be able to take over as Nvidia’s CEO given the company is navigating a mega-merger with rival Lumentum.
